verdict.rationale: Bolna's docs claim support for 40+ languages, including Indic languages with native accents, and say the agent detects and switches language mid-call on its own. The agent tab also lets developers add multiple languages, set a default and write a prompt per language. All of this is first-party claim with thin detail on how detection and switching actually work. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the detection and switching mechanism and its configuration, which STT/TTS providers support switching, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
